blurb: This control checks whether the portmap service, the RPC port mapper, is running on the system. It flags portmap when it is set to start at boot in the file /etc/rc.tcpip or is already active as a running service. If portmap runs while nothing on the system genuinely needs RPC, it gives a remote attacker a live list of the services and port numbers to attack, plus a well-known network service with a long history of security flaws.
